facts.text: Known as the "Defender of the Core", for millennia it was the site of the Republic Navy's primary fleet base and War College.

evidence.quote: Known as the "Defender of the Core", for millennia it was the site of the Republic Navy's primary fleet base and War College.

facts.text: It was considered the site of naval power, tradition and prestige by both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire.

details.affiliation: Confederacy of Independent Systems, Trench's army, PM-6986 Separatist holdout

facts.text: Pols Anaxes was the primary civilian spaceport of the planet Anaxes. Home to the Anaxes Citadel, it was surrounding by the terraced Sirpar Hills which were places of utmost grace and nearly all motorized vehicles were banned.

evidence.quote: Pols Anaxes was the primary civilian spaceport of the planet Anaxes. Home to the Anaxes Citadel, it was surrounding by the terraced Sirpar Hills which were places of utmost grace and nearly all motorized vehicles were banned.

facts.text: The Anaxes Citadel was a massive complex of training schools, research labs, intelligence centers, offices, archives, and parade grounds on the planet Anaxes. It served as the primary governmental building for the planet.

facts.text: Anaxes Station was a space station located near Anaxes in the fringes of the Axum system.

facts.text: The Sirpar Hills were the terraced hillsides surrounding the Anaxes Citadel in Pols Anaxes, on the planet Anaxes. As with the spaceport most vehicles were banned in the Sirpar Hills, so residents would switch out their vehicles for Keffis at the nearby Sirpar Station.

evidence.quote: The Sirpar Hills were the terraced hillsides surrounding the Anaxes Citadel in Pols Anaxes, on the planet Anaxes. As with the spaceport most vehicles were banned in the Sirpar Hills, so residents would switch out their vehicles for Keffis at the nearby Sirpar Station.

facts.text: Sirpar Station was a transfer station located at the entrance to the Sirpar Hills and Pols Anaxes, on the planet Anaxes. It was here that the Anaxsi exchanged their landspeeders and groundcars for Keffis.

facts.text: The Battle of Anaxes—also known as the battle for Anaxes, the battle on Anaxes, and the defense of Anaxes—was a prolonged engagement that was fought on the planet Anaxes for several months during the Outer Rim Sieges in 19 BBY, the final year of the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: The Battle of Anaxes—also known as the battle for Anaxes, the battle on Anaxes, and the defense of Anaxes—was a prolonged engagement that was fought on the planet Anaxes for several months during the Outer Rim Sieges in 19 BBY, the final year of the Clone Wars.

facts.outcome: Galactic Republic victory, Prevention of Anaxes capture by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Death of Admiral Trench

facts.text: The Battle of Anaxes of 20.1 BBY was the final confrontation between the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Bulwark Fleet and the Galactic Republic's Victory Fleet during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: The Battle of Anaxes of 20.1 BBY was the final confrontation between the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Bulwark Fleet and the Galactic Republic's Victory Fleet during the Clone Wars.

facts.date: 20.1 BBY (15:4), 23 months after the Battle of Geonosis

facts.text: In 10 ABY, during the Imperial offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand, after driving the New Republic from the galactic capital of Coruscant, Imperial forces pursued the retreating New Republic along the Perlemian Trade Route and attacked Anaxes.
